scope: Fresh independent static code, native authority, transport custody and budget-contract review; source/gold excluded; connected mock artifacts not yet reviewed.

findings.title: Require the native Astra profile at final authority validation
findings.problem: Any missing or foreign Astra authority_profile skips the native envelope, output and request-body validation. The builder invokes this validator directly when reopening a report, so the stronger profile requirement in RetainedSourceOnlyReader does not close final report tamper/downgrade acceptance.
findings.evidence: No-network direct calls to validate_source_record accepted both a foreign and a missing profile with invalid native_response_json, invalid native_response_sha256 and request_sha256, and nonexistent image_path, when the hand-authored policy/schema/image metadata and empty SourcePageReview were valid.
findings.correction: Require explicit provider=openai and authority_profile=openai-native-astra-source-only-medium-v1, then perform all existing Astra native envelope/request checks unconditionally. Retain legacy artifacts unchanged under their producing snapshot; do not reseal them. Add missing/foreign profile and final builder report downgrade rejection coverage.

findings.title: Pin standard OpenAI service before applying standard-rate admission
findings.problem: The native guard treats omitted service_tier as default although OpenAI omission follows project service settings. Actual Astra reader and common OCR bodies omit service_tier. A Fast project setting therefore invalidates the standard-price reservation assumption; settlement also ignores the served response tier.
findings.evidence: No-network _native call accepted an OpenAI request without service_tier; _usage/_cost calculated standard USD0.06 for a synthetic Fast response with1000 input and1000 output tokens. Official Fast-mode documentation states that omitted service_tier inherits the project Fast setting and response.service_tier reports the served tier.
findings.correction: Explicitly set service_tier=default in the actual Astra reader/common OCR native payloads and their frozen body builders; require it at pre-POST admission. Check actual response tier before standard settlement and fail closed with retained conservative liability if the served tier is absent or differs. Re-freeze/replay affected request hashes without changing provider account settings.

other_observations: Google authority explicitly selects its provider/profile and binds native body/image/policy/schema; hidden thought parts are excluded from visible output.

Campaign guard wraps both synchronous httpx/httpx2 Client.send paths, inspects URL-selected transport retries, serializes with flock, durably saves admission intent before exclusive request receipt and POST, retains unknown reservations, and preserves duplicate-stage denial. These are static observations, not live billing proof.

Final acceptance still requires owner correction, focused regression evidence and current connected four-export/expected-hold artifact proof. No source fidelity, provider callability, live latency/value, or full integration acceptance is established by this review.
